headline: LAA @ DET matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is LAA 4.25 at DET 4.54, with a projected total of 8.79. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward LAA: LAA moved +0.72 runs while DET moved -0.24, changing the projected margin by +0.96 runs. The projected total climbed +0.47, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -20.8%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Keider Montero has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Kevin McGonigle, Nolan Schanuel, Oswald Peraza, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Sebastián Rivero, Jose Siri because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
